about: Visible ISS passes over Ypsilanti, Michigan, as listed by Heavens-Above. Typed in by hand from the 8-row table in .autopilot/research/track-orbit-math-passes-prior-art.md section 4 (the Heavens-Above column only). The Heavens-Above page itself was not copied and is never scraped by the tests.
retrieved: 2026-11-14, one fetch during the research run of 12:36-12:55 PM EST (the exact minute was not recorded)
timeZone: EST (UTC-5); every time below is Eastern Standard Time

window.note: Heavens-Above lists visible passes for 10 days; the 8 rows here are all of its rows for Nov 14-18. The test searches the same span: from the start of the research run to midnight at the end of Nov 18 (EST).

rules: Heavens-Above lists a pass from the moment it is visible above 10 degrees (or leaves Earth's shadow) to the moment it drops below 10 degrees (or enters the shadow); its highest point is the highest visible point, in whole degrees.
